stem: In the past 30 days, when a wave of heat has come over you in the middle of something — a meeting, a conversation, behind the wheel — how severe has it actually been?
In the past 30 days, when night sweats have happened — whether or not they woke you fully — how severe have they been? (Damp pillow, changed pajamas, woke up overheated all count.)
In the past 30 days, how often have hot flushes or sweats made you step away, change clothes, lose your train of thought, or quietly work around them in ways that took up real space in your day?
In the past 30 days, when your heart has felt different from baseline — racing, pounding, fluttering, or simply too loud at rest — how severe have those episodes been?
In the past 30 days, how severe have headaches been — including any change from your prior pattern in when they happen, how they feel, or what brings them on?
In the past 30 days, how often have you been awake in the middle of the night — alert, mind running — unable to settle back into sleep before the alarm?
In the past 30 days, how often have you woken in the morning feeling that the sleep you got didn’t actually restore you — even when the hours on paper looked fine?
In the past 30 days, how often have you had to actively fight off sleep during the day — in meetings, behind the wheel, sitting down for a moment — even after a full night in bed?
Has anyone who has shared a sleeping space with you ever told you that you snore loudly, gasp, choke, or stop breathing during sleep? (Even if it was years ago, even if you didn’t believe them.)
options: Don’t know — I sleep alone or unobserved

stem: In the past 30 days, how often have temperature changes — flushes, sweats, or feeling overheated — been the actual reason your sleep broke?
In the past 3 cycles, how often has your mood, irritability, or capacity dropped sharply in the days before your period and lifted within a few days of bleeding starting? (Time frame: 3 cycles.)
In the past 3 cycles, how often have your focus, sleep, or energy followed a clear pattern tied to where you were in your cycle — sharper at one phase, dulled at another? (Time frame: 3 cycles.)
In the past 12 months, which of the following bleeding changes have you experienced? (Select all that apply.)
options: Periods heavier than they used to be

stem: In the past 30 days, how severe has menstrual or pelvic pain been — including pain that no longer tracks neatly with your period?
In the past 30 days, how severe has vaginal or vulvar dryness been in your daily life — sitting, walking, exercising, wearing certain clothes — not only during intimacy?
In the past 30 days, how severe has vaginal or vulvar burning, irritation, or itching been?
In the past 30 days, how severe has discomfort or pain during sexual activity been — at entry, with deeper contact, or after?
In the past 30 days, how severe has urinary urgency or frequency been — sudden need to go, or going far more often than you used to?
In the past 30 days, how severe has unwanted urine leakage been — with cough, sneeze, exercise, urgency, or laughing?
In the past 12 months, how many urinary tract infections have you had?
In the past 30 days, how often have you noticed a clear drop in sexual desire compared to your own prior baseline — not compared to anyone else’s, just compared to you?
In the past 30 days, how severe has difficulty with arousal, lubrication, or physical sexual response been compared to your prior baseline?
If you are experiencing any sexual symptoms, how bothered are you by them — not how bothered you think you should be, just how bothered you actually are? (Mark "Not at all" if no symptoms.)
In the past 30 days, how severe has joint pain been — in your hands, wrists, shoulders, hips, knees, or jaw — including pain that wasn’t there before?
In the past 30 days, how severe has joint stiffness been — in the morning, after sitting, or when you first start moving?
In the past 30 days, how severe has muscle pain or weakness been — including new difficulty with strength tasks (lifting, carrying, opening) you used to do without thinking?
In the past 12 months, have you experienced any of the following? (Select all that apply.)
options: New shoulder pain or restricted shoulder movement (frozen-shoulder pattern)
New or accelerated low back pain
Loss of muscle tone or strength noticeable to you
Bone fracture from a low-impact fall or no clear cause
Diagnosed osteopenia or osteoporosis on DEXA

stem: In the past 30 days, how often has your physical energy felt clearly different from your prior baseline — running out earlier, recovering more slowly, or feeling depleted at rest?
In the past 30 days, how often have you needed to lie down, nap, or stop functioning in order to recover from ordinary activity — or had a "next-day crash" you didn’t used to have?
In the past 30 days, how often have you noticed unexplained changes in your body — increased belly fat, muscle loss, or weight that isn’t responding to what used to work?
When did you last have a complete metabolic panel, thyroid panel, B12, ferritin, vitamin D, and HbA1c checked?
In the past 30 days, how often have you been unable to wind down or feel calm — even when you finally had time to rest?
In the past 30 days, how often has your body stayed activated — racing heart, tension, jitteriness — long after the stressful moment had actually ended?
In the past 30 days, how often has irritability or anger shown up in your body — clenched jaw, tight chest, gut tension — before you noticed it in your thoughts or mood?
In the past 30 days, how often have noise, light, crowds, clothing, or smells felt clearly more overwhelming than they used to?
In the past 30 days, how often have you needed to step away, retreat, or physically remove from environments that others around you found tolerable?
In the past 30 days, how often has sensory overload — noise, light, crowds, smells — been the trigger for a mood, focus, or energy crash later in the day or the next day?
In the past 30 days, how often have you noticed your mind working differently than it did 2–5 years ago — in ways that feel like a real change in your baseline, not just stress?
In the past 30 days, how often have your cognitive changes — focus, memory, word recall — felt connected to physical changes like sleep, energy, hot flashes, cycle, or recovery?
In the past 30 days, how often have you felt that something fundamental about how your brain works is shifting — not just that you are tired, stressed, or overloaded?
Compared to your prior baseline, how often in the past 30 days have you needed more cognitive effort to do tasks that used to feel automatic?
